title: Surreal Elemental Dreamscape
description: A vibrant surreal collage featuring a large purple and green lotus flower in the upper left, a dark spiky monster with a glowing red eye in the upper right, a translucent blue-maned horse galloping across the center, a woman's face with tears superimposed over a green circular landscape, and a detailed sea turtle swimming in the lower right.
prompt: Surreal fantasy collage with a large intricate purple lotus with green center in the top left, a monstrous black spiky creature with a giant glowing red eye and tentacles in the top right, a translucent blue fiery horse with flowing mane galloping through the middle, a woman's face with tears emerging from a green circular frame showing a red sunset landscape, and a highly detailed sea turtle swimming underwater in the bottom right, dramatic cinematic lighting, vibrant color palette blending land sea and sky elements
